comment: WITH is not an unconditional allowance: libZ offers 'GPL-2.0 WITH Classpath-2.0 OR GPL-2.0'. The dynamic-link rule is waived ONLY on the branch that actually carries the Classpath-2.0 exception (cost: 1 exception). The plain GPL-2.0 branch is infeasible here. Synthetic rules, not legal conclusions.

propagation.message: dynamic dependents of strong-copyleft must be copyleft unless Classpath-2.0 exception applies
